desc: The BOLT L35R is a no-nonsense thermal weapon sight built for hunters who demand reliability and real-world performance. At its core is a 384x288 12m sensor paired with a crisp 35mm F1.0 lens, offering excellent image clarity and a detection range of up to 1,800 yards. The 1024x768 AMOLED display provides sharp, smooth visuals, even in the worst conditions. With built-in photo and video recording (with audio), WiFi connectivity, multiple zeroing profiles, and standard 18650 battery compatibility for up to 6.5 hours of total runtime, the L35R is packed with features designed for serious hunters. It mounts easily using standard 30mm rings and is housed in a rugged, IP67-rated aluminum body.
